checks.name: animal_weight_outside_believable_range
checks.question: Is every recorded animal weight one a goat could actually have?
checks.sql: select o.scanned_identifier as tag, o.weight_kg::text as weight, o.created_at::date::text as recorded_on from public.weighing_observations o where o.weight_kg is not null and (o.weight_kg < 0.5 or o.weight_kg > 150) order by o.created_at desc limit 500
checks.humanFailure: Some animals are recorded at a weight no goat can be. Every average, growth rate and weight band built on those rows is pulled off by them, and the pens they sit in read wrong on the Weights page.
checks.countUnit: animals recorded at an impossible weight
checks.why: The existing check only rejects zero and below, so a scale left in grams, a double-entered digit or a pen total typed into an animal row all pass. d085b2a4d is the family: a figure that is arithmetically possible and physically not.

checks.name: pen_weighing_with_no_average_to_show
checks.question: Does every whole-pen weighing carry the average it is supposed to display?
checks.sql: select s.weight_kg::text as pen_total, s.animal_count::text as animals, s.created_at::date::text as recorded_on from public.weighing_shed_observations s where s.weight_kg > 0 and s.animal_count > 0 and s.average_weight_kg is null order by s.created_at desc limit 500
checks.humanFailure: Some pens were weighed as a whole and have no average stored for them, so those pens show a blank where their average weight belongs while the animals still count towards the totals above.
checks.countUnit: whole-pen weighings with no average
checks.why: The average-versus-total check compares the stored average with the total over the head count, and a NULL average passes it because there is nothing to compare. Proven silent by feeding it that exact row.

checks.name: pen_weighing_counted_against_nobody
checks.question: Does every whole-pen weighing say how many animals it covers?
checks.sql: select s.weight_kg::text as pen_total, s.average_weight_kg::text as stored_average, s.created_at::date::text as recorded_on from public.weighing_shed_observations s where s.weight_kg > 0 and coalesce(s.animal_count, 0) <= 0 order by s.created_at desc limit 500
checks.humanFailure: Some pens were weighed as a whole with no head count recorded, so that pen's weight belongs to no animals at all and every per-animal figure built from it is missing those kids.
checks.countUnit: whole-pen weighings covering no animals
checks.why: 3c771ffc7 moved the head count off the operator's keyboard because operators kept typing it wrong. A zero head count is the form that survives that fix and it divides every average by nothing.

checks.question: Does every vaccination record point at an animal and a due dose that still exist?
checks.sql:
SELECT vc.completion_id, vc.obligation_id, vc.goat_id, vc.administered_at
FROM public.vaccination_completions vc
LEFT JOIN public.obligation_instances oi ON oi.obligation_id = vc.obligation_id
LEFT JOIN public.goats g ON g.goat_id = vc.goat_id
WHERE oi.obligation_id IS NULL OR g.goat_id IS NULL
LIMIT 50
checks.humanFailure: Some vaccinations are recorded against a due dose or an animal that no longer exists, so the doses used and the coverage figure both count something nothing ever asked for.
checks.countUnit: vaccinations recorded against a dose or animal that is gone

checks.name: finished_work_has_a_finish_time
checks.question: Does every task marked done or cancelled record when that happened, and who it belongs to?
checks.sql:
SELECT task_id, task_no, title, status, assignee_user_id, raised_at, done_at, cancelled_at
FROM public.leadership_tasks
WHERE (status = 'done' AND done_at IS NULL)
   OR (status IN ('cancelled', 'canceled') AND cancelled_at IS NULL)
   OR (status NOT IN ('done', 'cancelled', 'canceled') AND (done_at IS NOT NULL OR cancelled_at IS NOT NULL))
   OR done_at < raised_at
LIMIT 50
checks.humanFailure: Some jobs are shown as finished or cancelled with no time recorded against them, or carry a finish time while still open, so the work-done figures cannot be trusted.
checks.countUnit: jobs whose finish time does not match their state

checks.name: tag_last_seen_is_not_in_the_future
checks.question: Are the ear tag readings dated sensibly, or is a tag reporting from the future?
checks.sql:
SELECT tag_id, tag_mac, gateway_id, last_seen_at, signal_state, battery_mv, mapping_state
FROM public.herd_signal_tag_latest
WHERE last_seen_at > now() + interval '10 minutes'
   OR (battery_mv IS NOT NULL AND (battery_mv <= 0 OR battery_mv > 4000))
LIMIT 50
checks.humanFailure: Some tags are shown as last seen at a time that has not happened yet, or reporting an impossible battery level, so the page cannot be used to tell which tags are actually alive.
checks.countUnit: tags last seen in the future or reporting an impossible battery

checks.name: one_feed_rate_covers_one_day
checks.question: Are there two different feed rates in force for the same group and feed item at once?
checks.sql:
SELECT a.ration_rate_id AS rate_a,
       b.ration_rate_id AS rate_b,
       a.park_id,
       a.ration_group_label,
       a.shed_tag_label,
       a.feed_item_label,
       a.grams_per_head AS grams_a,
       b.grams_per_head AS grams_b,
       a.valid_from AS from_a,
       b.valid_from AS from_b
FROM public.feed_ration_rates a
JOIN public.feed_ration_rates b
  ON b.tenant_id = a.tenant_id
 AND b.park_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM a.park_id
 AND b.ration_group_key = a.ration_group_key
 AND b.shed_tag_key IS NOT DISTINCT FROM a.shed_tag_key
 AND b.feed_item_key = a.feed_item_key
 AND b.ration_rate_id > a.ration_rate_id
 AND b.valid_from < COALESCE(a.valid_to, 'infinity'::timestamptz)
 AND a.valid_from < COALESCE(b.valid_to, 'infinity'::timestamptz)
LIMIT 50
checks.humanFailure: Two feed rates for the same pen and the same feed cover the same days with different amounts, so the feed sheet can show either amount and the feed issued cannot be reconciled against it.
checks.countUnit: pairs of feed rates that cover the same days
